properties.name: WHAT WORKED (2026-10-02, 0.77.0): `--call create_edges` with `check_only: true` validates a whole batch, lists each failure by index and writes nothing. It is the door agent's cheapest way to learn edge shapes before writing. Do not regress it
properties.statement:
From art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02, measured table row "`--call create_edges` with `\"check_only\": true` | validates the batch and writes nothing", and the working pattern "check_only for an edge batch".

Re-measured by triage agent B on 0.77.0, scratch store. A two-edge batch, one valid DEPENDS_ON and one with edge_type NOT_A_TYPE, returned exit 0 with {applied: false, check_only: true, checked: 2, would_apply: false, failures: [{index: 1, error: "Unknown edge type: NOT_A_TYPE"}]} and a note to resend the whole batch. A propagate_from depth-1 read afterwards found no edge on the source node, so nothing was written.

The refusal shape is the one the report asks every write to have: all of it checked at once, nothing half-written. Typed constructors do not yet do this (the report's L17, another triage slice).
